feedback: Written before this candidate races. The evidence supports holding the geometry this iteration. Iteration 5 showed that y = 0.07 m gave no slalom gain over y = 0.06 m (slalom max_error stayed at 0.063 m, progress 0.260 to 0.278), so look-ahead is saturated. Iterations 7 to 9 showed the integral and proportional gains are flattening: ki 0.4 to 0.7 moved slalom progress only from about 0.319 to 0.320 (iterations 7 and 8), and kp 2.4 to 2.8 moved it from 0.320 to 0.331 with max_error unchanged at about 0.063 m (iterations 8 and 9). Line losses stay near 1 per run, far below the 2-per-run spread trigger. So the controller is near its limit, and the remaining failure looks like reversal reaction. I am testing a single controller change (kd up to 1.0) with your geometry held, which gives a clean baseline for the next step. I state no outcome for this candidate. For the next geometry step: if the slalom still fails at max_error near 0.063 m with progress near 0.33 after this race, test wheel_track of about 0.10 m at y = 0.07 m with the spread unchanged, as you planned. Do not move y further forward. If slalom line losses rise above about 2 per run with progress below 0.2, widen the spread to x = ±0.032 m. If oval or s-bend completion falls below 20 of 20 and 18 of 20, revert to y = 0.06 m.
